item.title: Shinshu Soba: Nagano's Celebrated Buckwheat Noodles — Guide
item.description: Shinshu soba (buckwheat noodles) is one of Nagano’s signature foods, the region’s cool climate, clean mountain water and buckwheat-friendly highland terrain making it one of Japan’s most celebrated soba-producing areas. The noodles are prized for their firm texture and rich, nutty buckwheat flavour, served cold with dipping sauce or hot in broth at countless restaurants across the prefecture, and many places also offer hands-on soba-making classes where visitors mix, roll, and cut their own noodles under a master’s guidance before eating them fresh.
